title: Patroni: pg_dump backup
description: Runs `nexus backup take postgres --tag smoke`: pg_dump of nexus_smoke over TLS+scram on a streaming replica (--no-owner --no-privileges), node-local gzip.

observe.what: node-local /var/backups/nexus-patroni/<id>.sql.gz with a non-zero byte size (~650 B)

whatProves: PatroniAdapter.BackupTakeAsync dumps as the operator over scram from a replica (offloads the leader); --no-owner/--no-privileges keep the dump replayable under the non-owner operator role (ADR-0013 bug #3).
